basic_info.description: Experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience in this elegantly updated one-bedroom, one-bath residence, complete with a separate vanity area. Located in a prestigious hi-rise, this approximately 750 sf home boasts expansive views, beautiful engineered wood flooring, and the comfort of in-unit laundry. The standout feature of this unit is its versatile floor-to-ceiling bay window alcove that frames breathtaking views of San Francisco. Whether you choose to use it as an extended living area, a home office, a dining nook, or even a workout zone, the possibilities are endless. The thoughtfully updated kitchen and bath enhance both style and functionality, while dedicated parking and storage add to the ease of urban living. Nestled in a dynamic neighborhood near the Ballet, Symphony, Opera, & SFJazz Center, this home offers easy access to San Francisco's vibrant arts scene. Enjoy the convenience of Whole Foods, Polk St amenities, and excellent public transportation & tech shuttle options, all just moments away. Effortless day trips or commutes in & out of the city are possible with convenient hwy access. Enjoy luxury bldg amenities, including 24-hour security, a year-round heated pool, sauna, spa and gym. HOA dues cover AT&T hi-speed internet, water, trash and sewer.
